readerCopy.body: Trying to sound reasonable can become a way of hiding the point you are most afraid will make you unacceptable. When Mercury squares Lilith, the need to keep a conversation smooth can collide with a sentence that refuses to become harmless just because you softened the wording. That is how resentment leaks out sideways: the careful message gets sarcastic, the polite answer carries a sting, or you keep explaining everything except the actual objection. The problem may not be your tone. It may be that you are trying to make a genuine no sound enough like yes that nobody has to respond to it.
